description: A woman presents a homemade version of a viral snack, "Tang Yuan Wijen Hitam" (Black Sesame Tang Yuan), which she describes as essentially filled ronde. She wraps each dough piece around the black filling, seals it completely, and shapes it like a fishball. The balls are boiled for about 2-3 minutes until they float, then served in a bowl with plain milk boiled with grated ginger. She notes they can be frozen and boiled fresh when needed.
